title: Choose the art direction
question: Three directions built from your references (Motion, Labis, Shiddo), each with a real comp of the landing’s first screen. Pick one and I rebuild /brand in it.

options.label: Canopy
options.lineage: Labis and Shiddo, a Brazilian rainforest at night
options.thesis: A dark green studio page with an editorial serif and the snake as a carved 3D emblem.
options.viewport: Serif headline left with mint emphasis, the extruded snake emblem right, client work / open source / one team below the fold line.
options.risk: Closest to Labis and Shiddo, so the emblem has to carry the difference.

options.label: Signal
options.lineage: Motion’s night: the particle sphere becomes the mark
options.thesis: Near-black, one signal yellow, and the logo as a living particle field that forms on load and parts around the cursor.
options.viewport: The particle mark fills the stage; headline bottom-left, Get in touch in yellow bottom-right, Motion’s layout.
options.risk: Reads as a dev-tool site; founders may need the copy to say ‘software house’ out loud.

options.label: Calçadão
options.lineage: Motion’s light footer meets Copacabana’s wave pavement
options.thesis: Stone white and black, a heavy grotesk, and the s’s curve repeated into Copacabana’s pavement waves.
options.viewport: Huge three-line headline left, a numbered index right like Motion’s partner list, the pavement waves owning the lower third.
options.risk: Light-first and loud; the waves must stay a band, never a wallpaper behind text.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A white agency page: blue accent, Inter, product screenshots in a grid.
canonCard.viewport: Centred headline, two buttons, a row of service cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other software house by design.
